_comment: Easy Mode tile copy, verbatim from docs/plans/filters-for-fuckwits.md. Keyed by grid, then preset id, matching store/easy.js PRESETS; knob labels and option labels are keyed by the knob and option ids that module declares. Owner-approved text: edits here are copy changes.
notice: These presets intentionally simplify a complex topic; only a handful of HQPlayer's capabilities are accessible here. Full optimization for your system and tastes requires further experimentation. Think of Easy Mode as training wheels.

add.title: Save your own
add.description: Turn your current filter settings into a tile.

perfect-ten.description: Does everything well, no strings attached. Start here.

lifelike.title: Lifelike

perfect-ten.title: The Perfect Ten
perfect-ten.description: Does everything well, no strings attached. Other presets are trade-offs. Start here.
perfect-ten.note: 'Transients' corrects errors less aggressively than 'Balanced' or 'Space'; if it sounds harsh, try another setting.

hires.title: The Perfect Ten: Hi-res Mode
hires.description: A version of The Perfect Ten optimized for rates 88.2 kHz and up. Also suitable for lossy MQAs and MP3s.

lifelike.title: Lifelike
lifelike.description: Puts the focus on natural, realistic timbre.
lifelike.note: 'Transients' corrects errors less aggressively than 'Balanced' or 'Space'; if it sounds harsh, try another setting.

old-school.title: Old School
old-school.description: Excellent with classic-era analog recordings. Less aggressive error correction; if it sounds harsh, try another setting.

purist.title: The Purist
purist.description: Passes the original samples through unchanged. Consumes more resources. No error correction: only recommended for the highest technical quality source material.

damage-control.title: Damage Control
damage-control.description: Aggressive clean-up for loudness war-era and other less-than-good material.

concert-hall.title: The Concert Hall
concert-hall.description: Emphasizes the recording's space at the cost of transient performance more than other presets. For material like live classical with minimal transient content. Consumes heavy resources.
concert-hall.note: Turning error correction off reduces resource consumption.
